_comment: Citable loan-program rules, one entry per rule, referenced from posts with
a [[RULE:key]] marker. Same architecture as neighborhoods.json: the volatile
thing lives in one data file and the posts carry markers, so refreshing the
whole site after a handbook update is one edit rather than forty.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A page on a licensed originator's site that asserts
'FHA requires X' and is eighteen months stale is worse than a page that
says nothing, because the reader acts on it and the NMLS number at the
bottom is a real person's. Every rule here therefore carries three things:
the handbook section it comes from, the date a human verified it against
that section, and the text itself. Nothing is written from memory.
THREE RENDER STATES, all handled by gen/guidelines.py:
1. verifiedOn is null -> the page renders an honest line saying the current
requirement is confirmed per file, with a phone number. It does NOT
state a number. This is the default and it is deliberately safe, so a
post can publish before anyone has opened the handbook.
2. verifiedOn is recent -> renders the rule, the handbook citation and the
verification date.
3. verifiedOn older than STALE_DAYS -> renders the rule plus a visible
notice saying how old the verification is.
HOW A RULE GETS VERIFIED. Open the cited handbook section, read it, and
record what it actually says. Then run:
python gen/verify_guideline.py <key> --section '<cite>' --text '<rule>'
That stamps verifiedOn with today and writes the text. Never hand-edit a
verifiedOn date, and never stamp a rule you did not read.
THE OVERLAY DISTINCTION, which is the whole point of the content strategy.
The handbook is a floor, not the market. Investors layer their own stricter
requirements on top, and the gap between the two is where a borrower
actually lives. `handbookFloor` is the published rule. `overlayReality` is
what lenders actually do, which is Ricky's observation and is labelled as
such rather than presented as a published requirement. Keep them separate.
Conflating them is how a page becomes wrong.
SOURCES. FHA rules cite the HUD Single Family Housing Policy Handbook
4000.1, which is a US government work and free to quote. VA cites the
Lenders Handbook M26-7. Conventional cites the Fannie Mae Selling Guide or
the Freddie Mac Seller/Servicer Guide. Cite the section, not just the
document.

ruleSchema.program: FHA | VA | USDA | Conventional | Jumbo | Non-QM
ruleSchema.topic: credit | income | assets | collateral | employment | residency | obligations | process
ruleSchema.question: The rule in borrower language, used as the aside heading.
ruleSchema.handbookFloor: What the published guideline says. Null until verified.
ruleSchema.section: The citation, e.g. 'Handbook 4000.1 II.A.4.b'. Null until verified.
ruleSchema.verifiedOn: YYYY-MM-DD, the date a human read that section. Null by default.
ruleSchema.overlayReality: Optional. What investors actually do, labelled as Ricky's observation, not as a published rule.
ruleSchema.judgmentNeeded: Optional note on what Ricky still has to add to the page.

fha-min-credit-score.question: What credit score does FHA actually require?
fha-min-credit-score.judgmentNeeded: The overlay gap is the entire value of this page. What is the lowest score you have actually closed, and how many investors would touch it?

fha-gift-funds.question: Can the FHA down payment be a gift?
fha-gift-funds.judgmentNeeded: Which donor documentation requests kill the most deals in practice?

fha-bankruptcy-waiting-period.question: How long after a bankruptcy can I get an FHA loan?
fha-bankruptcy-waiting-period.judgmentNeeded: Chapter 13 while still in plan: have you closed one, and what did the trustee letter need to say?

fha-foreclosure-waiting-period.question: How long after a foreclosure or short sale?

fha-student-loan-payment.question: How is a student loan payment counted if it is deferred or on an income-driven plan?
fha-student-loan-payment.judgmentNeeded: This rule changed in recent years. Worth saying what the practical effect was on borrowers you were working with.

fha-self-employed-history.question: How long do I need to be self-employed for an FHA loan?
fha-self-employed-history.judgmentNeeded: The same-industry exception is the whole answer for a lot of people. How have you documented prior experience successfully?

fha-child-support-income.question: Does child support or alimony count as income?

fha-child-support-obligation.question: How does child support I pay affect what I qualify for?

fha-mip-duration.question: How long do I pay FHA mortgage insurance?
fha-mip-duration.judgmentNeeded: The refinance-out-of-FHA play is the practical answer. When does it make sense and when does it not?

fha-loan-limit-maricopa.question: What is the FHA loan limit in Maricopa County?
fha-loan-limit-maricopa.judgmentNeeded: This is published annually by HUD by county. Needs a yearly refresh, not a one-time verification.

fha-occupancy-requirement.question: Do I have to live in the house?

fha-two-fha-loans.question: Can I have two FHA loans at once?
fha-two-fha-loans.judgmentNeeded: The relocation and family-size exceptions are where this gets interesting. Closed any?

fha-non-occupant-coborrower.question: Can a parent co-sign an FHA loan?

fha-seller-concession-limit.question: How much can the seller pay toward my FHA closing costs?
fha-seller-concession-limit.judgmentNeeded: Ties directly into the buydown content. How often does the FHA cap bind before the seller's willingness does?

fha-appraisal-repairs.question: What will an FHA appraiser make the seller fix?
fha-appraisal-repairs.judgmentNeeded: The listing-agent angle: which FHA appraisal call-outs most often blow up a resale, and how do you get ahead of them?

fha-manual-underwrite.question: What is a manual underwrite and why am I in one?
fha-manual-underwrite.judgmentNeeded: Compensating factors are judgment. Which ones actually move an underwriter?

fha-dti-limits.question: What debt-to-income ratio will FHA allow?
fha-dti-limits.judgmentNeeded: The spread between the TOTAL Scorecard answer and the manual answer is the real story.

fha-collections-judgments.question: Do I have to pay off collections and judgments?

fha-cash-to-close-sourcing.question: Where can my down payment and closing costs come from?

fha-employment-gap.question: I changed jobs or had a gap. Does that disqualify me?

fha-non-permanent-resident.question: Can I get an FHA loan without being a US citizen?
fha-non-permanent-resident.judgmentNeeded: Work authorization documentation is where these stall. What do you ask for on the first call?

fha-condo-approval.question: Does the condo have to be FHA approved?
fha-condo-approval.judgmentNeeded: Single-unit approval exists. Have you used it, and how long did it take?

fha-caivrs-federal-debt.question: Can unpaid federal debt stop my FHA loan?

fha-streamline-refinance.question: What is an FHA streamline refinance?

fha-203k-renovation.question: Can an FHA loan cover repairs?
